mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status IN ('PREPAY_CREATED', 'WAIT_CALLBACK') AND pr.expires_at < NOW() ), 0) AS expiredPaymentCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' ), 0) AS pendingCallbackCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_event WHERE publish_status = 'FAILED' ), 0) AS failedEventCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'FAIL' ), 0) AS failedRefundCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_day_end_batch WHERE batch_status = 'WARNING' ), 0) AS warningDayEndBatchCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_control_policy WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND COALESCE(self_check_status, 'WARN') <> 'PASS' ), 0) AS controlPolicyWarningCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT po.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT pnl.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT pe.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT po.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE (issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120) ), 0) AS overdueIssueCount

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT po.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT pnl.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT pe.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT po.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE (issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120)

SELECT issue_sla.issue_no AS issueNo, issue_sla.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, issue_sla.issue_type AS issueType, issue_sla.severity AS severity, COALESCE(roster.responsibility_group, '支付运营组') AS responsibilityGroup, COALESCE(roster.receiver, '支付运营') AS receiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_receiver, '支付值班负责人') AS escalationReceiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_policy, '超时未确认升级值班负责人') AS escalationPolicy, COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30) AS escalationTimeoutMinutes, COALESCE(roster.schedule_tag, '默认班次') AS scheduleTag, CASE WHEN roster.effective_start_hour IS NULL OR roster.effective_end_hour IS NULL THEN '00:00-23:00' WHEN roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour THEN CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') ELSE CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-次日', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') END AS effectiveWindow, CONCAT('支付异常 ', issue_sla.issue_no, ' 已超过 ', issue_sla.severity, ' SLA，请进入异常中心处理。') AS alertContent FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-WAIT-', po.payment_order_id) AS issue_no, po.payment_order_id, '待回调未收口' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, po.created_at FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-NOTIFY-', pnl.notify_no) AS issue_no, pnl.payment_order_id, '回调处理待跟进' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, pnl.created_at FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-EVENT-', pe.event_no) AS issue_no, pe.payment_order_id, '下游事件发布失败' AS issue_type, 'P2' AS severity, pe.created_at FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-CHANNEL-', po.payment_order_id) AS issue_no, po.payment_order_id, '命中停用渠道' AS issue_type, 'P2' AS severity, po.created_at FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla LEFT JOIN t_payment_issue_duty_roster roster ON roster.issue_type = issue_sla.issue_type AND roster.severity = issue_sla.severity AND roster.status = 'ENABLED' AND FIND_IN_SET(WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1, roster.weekday_scope) > 0 AND ( roster.holiday_strategy = 'ALL_DAYS' OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'NON_WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) IN (1, 7)) ) AND ( (roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour AND HOUR(NOW()) BETWEEN roster.effective_start_hour AND roster.effective_end_hour) OR (roster.effective_start_hour > roster.effective_end_hour AND (HOUR(NOW()) >= roster.effective_start_hour OR HOUR(NOW()) <= roster.effective_end_hour)) ) WHERE ((issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log alert_log WHERE alert_log.issue_no = issue_sla.issue_no AND alert_log.ack_status = '待确认' ) ORDER BY issue_sla.created_at ASC, issue_no ASC

SELECT source_alert.issue_no AS issueNo, source_alert.alert_no AS sourceAlertNo, source_alert.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, source_alert.issue_type AS issueType, source_alert.severity AS severity, source_alert.responsibility_group AS responsibilityGroup, COALESCE(roster.escalation_receiver, source_alert.receiver) AS receiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_receiver, source_alert.receiver) AS escalationReceiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_policy, '超时未确认升级值班负责人') AS escalationPolicy, COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30) AS escalationTimeoutMinutes, COALESCE(roster.schedule_tag, '默认班次') AS scheduleTag, CASE WHEN roster.effective_start_hour IS NULL OR roster.effective_end_hour IS NULL THEN '00:00-23:00' WHEN roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour THEN CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') ELSE CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-次日', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') END AS effectiveWindow, CONCAT('升级来源告警 ', source_alert.alert_no, ' 已超过 ', COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30), ' 分钟未确认，请升级跟进。原告警：', source_alert.alert_content) AS alertContent FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log source_alert LEFT JOIN t_payment_issue_duty_roster roster ON roster.issue_type = source_alert.issue_type AND roster.severity = source_alert.severity AND roster.status = 'ENABLED' AND FIND_IN_SET(WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1, roster.weekday_scope) > 0 AND ( roster.holiday_strategy = 'ALL_DAYS' OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'NON_WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) IN (1, 7)) ) AND ( (roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour AND HOUR(NOW()) BETWEEN roster.effective_start_hour AND roster.effective_end_hour) OR (roster.effective_start_hour > roster.effective_end_hour AND (HOUR(NOW()) >= roster.effective_start_hour OR HOUR(NOW()) <= roster.effective_end_hour)) ) WHERE source_alert.alert_channel = 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND source_alert.ack_status = '待确认' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, source_alert.created_at, NOW()) >= COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log escalated_alert WHERE escalated_alert.issue_no = source_alert.issue_no AND escalated_alert.alert_channel = 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND escalated_alert.alert_content LIKE CONCAT('%升级来源告警 ', source_alert.alert_no, '%') ) ORDER BY source_alert.created_at ASC, source_alert.id ASC

SELECT task_log_no AS taskLogNo, task_code AS taskCode, task_name AS taskName, run_mode AS runMode, task_status AS taskStatus, task_status_type AS taskStatusType, processed_count AS processedCount, success_count AS successCount, warning_count AS warningCount, fail_count AS failCount, summary_comment AS summaryComment, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completedAt FROM t_payment_task_run_log ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_task_run_log ( task_log_no, task_code, task_name, run_mode, task_status, task_status_type, severity_level, severity_level_type, escalation_status, escalation_status_type, processed_count, success_count, warning_count, fail_count, summary_comment, suggested_action, recommended_route, triggered_by, started_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{taskLogNo}, #{taskCode}, #{taskName}, #{runMode}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskStatusType}, #{severityLevel}, #{severityLevelType}, #{escalationStatus}, #{escalationStatusType}, #{processedCount}, #{successCount}, #{warningCount}, #{failCount}, #{summaryComment}, #{suggestedAction}, #{recommendedRoute}, #{triggeredBy}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO t_payment_issue_alert_log ( alert_no, source_alert_no, issue_no, payment_order_id, issue_type, severity, responsibility_group, alert_channel, receiver, alert_status, alert_status_type, ack_status, ack_status_type, alert_content, provider_code, provider_name, endpoint_alias, template_code, provider_receipt_snapshot, provider_receipt_no, provider_delivery_status, provider_delivery_message, rendered_content_snapshot, triggered_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{alertNo}, #{sourceAlertNo}, #{issueNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{issueType}, #{severity}, #{responsibilityGroup}, #{alertChannel}, #{receiver}, #{alertStatus}, #{alertStatusType}, #{ackStatus}, #{ackStatusType}, #{alertContent}, #{providerCode}, #{providerName}, #{endpointAlias}, #{templateCode}, #{providerReceiptSnapshot}, #{providerReceiptNo}, #{providerDeliveryStatus}, #{providerDeliveryMessage}, #{renderedContentSnapshot}, #{triggeredBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT alert_no AS alertNo, issue_no AS issueNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, outbox.issue_type AS issueType, outbox.severity AS severity, outbox.responsibility_group AS responsibilityGroup, outbox.receiver AS receiver, COALESCE(roster.notify_channels, 'IN_APP,IM,SMS,EMAIL') AS notifyChannels, COALESCE(roster.escalation_level, 'L1') AS escalationLevel, COALESCE(roster.schedule_tag, '默认班次') AS scheduleTag, outbox.alert_content AS alertContent, outbox.triggered_by AS triggeredBy FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log outbox LEFT JOIN t_payment_issue_duty_roster roster ON roster.issue_type = outbox.issue_type AND roster.severity = outbox.severity AND roster.status = 'ENABLED' AND FIND_IN_SET(WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1, roster.weekday_scope) > 0 AND ( roster.holiday_strategy = 'ALL_DAYS' OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'NON_WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) IN (1, 7)) ) AND ( (roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour AND HOUR(NOW()) BETWEEN roster.effective_start_hour AND roster.effective_end_hour) OR (roster.effective_start_hour > roster.effective_end_hour AND (HOUR(NOW()) >= roster.effective_start_hour OR HOUR(NOW()) <= roster.effective_end_hour)) ) WHERE alert_channel = 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND alert_status IN ('已生成', '部分失败', '派发失败') ORDER BY outbox.created_at ASC, outbox.id ASC

SELECT alert_no AS alertNo, source_alert_no AS sourceAlertNo, issue_no AS issueNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, issue_type AS issueType, severity, responsibility_group AS responsibilityGroup, alert_channel AS alertChannel, receiver, alert_status AS alertStatus, alert_status_type AS alertStatusType, ack_status AS ackStatus, ack_status_type AS ackStatusType, alert_content AS alertContent, provider_code AS providerCode, provider_name AS providerName, endpoint_alias AS endpointAlias, template_code AS templateCode, provider_receipt_snapshot AS providerReceiptSnapshot, provider_receipt_no AS providerReceiptNo, provider_delivery_status AS providerDeliveryStatus, provider_delivery_message AS providerDeliveryMessage, rendered_content_snapshot AS renderedContentSnapshot, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, triggered_by AS triggeredBy FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log WHERE source_alert_no = #{param1} AND alert_channel = #{param2} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_code AS providerCode, provider_name AS providerName, channel_code AS channelCode, endpoint_alias AS endpointAlias, template_code AS templateCode, template_body AS templateBody, route_rule AS routeRule, route_priority AS routePriority, retry_policy AS retryPolicy, rate_limit_policy AS rateLimitPolicy, status, status_type AS statusType, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM t_payment_alert_provider_config WHERE channel_code = #{param1} AND status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY route_priority ASC, updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_issue_alert_log SET alert_status = #{alertStatus}, alert_status_type = #{alertStatusType}, ack_status = #{ackStatus}, ack_status_type = #{ackStatusType}, triggered_by = #{triggeredBy} WHERE alert_no = #{alertNo}
mapper.select: SELECT alert_no AS alertNo, issue_no AS issueNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, issue_type AS issueType, severity, responsibility_group AS responsibilityGroup, alert_channel AS alertChannel, receiver, alert_status AS alertStatus, alert_status_type AS alertStatusType, ack_status AS ackStatus, ack_status_type AS ackStatusType, alert_content AS alertContent, provider_code AS providerCode, provider_name AS providerName, endpoint_alias AS endpointAlias, template_code AS templateCode, provider_receipt_snapshot AS providerReceiptSnapshot, provider_receipt_no AS providerReceiptNo, provider_delivery_status AS providerDeliveryStatus, provider_delivery_message AS providerDeliveryMessage, rendered_content_snapshot AS renderedContentSnapshot, triggered_by AS triggeredBy FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log WHERE alert_channel <> 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND alert_status = '已派发' AND provider_delivery_status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_issue_alert_log SET provider_receipt_snapshot = #{providerReceiptSnapshot}, provider_delivery_status = #{providerDeliveryStatus}, provider_delivery_message = #{providerDeliveryMessage}, ack_status = #{ackStatus}, ack_status_type = #{ackStatusType}, triggered_by = #{triggeredBy} WHERE alert_no = #{alertNo} AND provider_delivery_status = 'ACCEPTED'
